mcq.question: A coding agent proposes committing a `.env` file that contains `OPENAI_API_KEY`. What is the best response?
options: Commit it because the repository is private.
Move the secret to an environment variable manager, rotate the exposed key, and add `.env` to `.gitignore`.
Rename the file to `env.backup` and commit it.
Ask the agent to minify the file so the key is less visible.
mcq.answer: Move the secret to an environment variable manager, rotate the exposed key, and add `.env` to `.gitignore`.

mcq.question: An AI-generated diff changes `WHERE user_id = ?` to `WHERE email = ?` without a migration. What should you review first?
options: Whether the new code is shorter.
Whether the query preserves authorization boundaries and has a compatible indexed column.
Whether the AI used modern syntax.
Whether the file has comments.
mcq.answer: Whether the query preserves authorization boundaries and has a compatible indexed column.

mcq.question: Which instruction gives an AI coding assistant the strongest context for a small production fix?
options: Fix the bug.
Make the app better.
Inspect `src/auth/session.ts`, preserve the existing API, add a regression test for expired sessions, and summarize the diff before final edits.
Rewrite authentication using a new framework.
mcq.answer: Inspect `src/auth/session.ts`, preserve the existing API, add a regression test for expired sessions, and summarize the diff before final edits.

mcq.question: A generated refactor breaks checkout in production. What is the safest first recovery move?
options: Ask the AI to refactor more files.
Restart the server repeatedly.
Identify the last known good deploy, stop further rollout, and choose rollback or fix-forward based on blast radius.
Delete the failing tests.
mcq.answer: Identify the last known good deploy, stop further rollout, and choose rollback or fix-forward based on blast radius.

mcq.question: Why does an AI-native product need evals in addition to unit tests?
options: Evals replace all tests.
Evals measure output quality and regressions for probabilistic behavior that unit tests cannot fully cover.
Evals make prompts private.
Evals are only for frontend apps.
mcq.answer: Evals measure output quality and regressions for probabilistic behavior that unit tests cannot fully cover.

mcq.question: The AI says a change is safe but did not run tests. What is the best reviewer action?
options: Accept because the model is confident.
Ask for the exact verification command and inspect the relevant diff and failure modes.
Only check formatting.
Merge if the app starts locally.
mcq.answer: Ask for the exact verification command and inspect the relevant diff and failure modes.

mcq.question: A minimal regression test should primarily prove what?
options: That the old bug would fail before the fix and pass after the fix.
That every line is covered.
That the implementation uses mocks everywhere.
That the UI has no visual issues.
mcq.answer: That the old bug would fail before the fix and pass after the fix.

mcq.question: What belongs in a plan-first prompt for a codebase task?
options: Target files, constraints, acceptance criteria, and verification commands.
Only the desired final code.
A request to skip reading existing patterns.
A list of unrelated feature ideas.
mcq.answer: Target files, constraints, acceptance criteria, and verification commands.

audit.title: P2 Code Audit: AI-generated authorization patch
audit.prompt: Review the AI-generated Express handler. List at least three findings with location, severity, and proposed fix.
expectedFindings: Missing ownership or role check before returning project data.
Authorization token is logged and may leak secrets.
The ID path parameter is trusted without validation.

recovery.title: P3 Recovery / Debug scenario
recovery.scenario: A coding agent changed session middleware and all admin routes now return 500. The latest deploy reached 20% of traffic. Error logs show `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'role')` in `requireAdmin`.
choices: Rollback the canary, inspect the diff, add a guard/regression test, then redeploy with verification.
Keep rollout moving and ask the AI to patch production directly.
